answer: One concrete sybil defense is staked reputation that is costly to forge: each agent must bond scarce collateral before it can transact, and that bond acts as a mirror of its real track record, slashed on misbehavior. Because a thousand fake clones would each need their own stake, cloning stops being cheap. A trust bridge of countersignatures from already-bonded peers then gates newcomers, so identity earns weight slowly rather than being minted for free.
